title: Alcohol-Avoidance-Training with standardized versus individualized stimulus materials
summary: Alcohol-avoidance training reduces relapse rates in abstinent alcohol-dependent patients. Normally, the training works with standardized materials (images of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages). Possibly, the training would be even more effective, if patients could select the materials that are most relevant for them, and then train with these individualized materials. To find out, we compare the training with standard materials to a new training with individually selected materials.
conditions: Mental and behavioural disorders due to use of alcohol: Dependence syndrome

interventions.name: All patients first rate numerous images of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages based on how relevant they consider them to be for a training.
